content.title: The Mandalorian and Grogu Movie: Trailer, Plot, Key Art & More | Explore Disney+
content.text: The clan of two heads to the silver screen.The upcoming Star Wars movie unites Mandalorian bounty hunter Din Djarin and his young apprentice Grogu for their first-ever theatrical adventure, coming to US theaters on May 22, 2026. You can check out the official trailer announcement over on StarWars.com and explore everything that’s been confirmed about the movie so far below, including how you can catch up on the flagship Disney+ series where their journey began. And visit the official The Mandalorian and Grogu page on StarWars.com for even more details.Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu, LucasfilmWhat’s the plot of The Mandalorian and Grogu?The evil Empire has fallen, and Imperial warlords remain scattered throughout the galaxy. As the fledgling New Republic works to protect everything the Rebellion fought for, they have enlisted the help of legendary Mandalorian bounty hunter Din Djarin (Pedro Pascal) and his young apprentice Grogu.Who’s behind The Mandalorian and Grogu?Jon Favreau directs and produces with Lucasfilm president Kathleen Kennedy and Dave Filoni also serving as producers for the upcoming film. Who’s who in The Mandalorian and Grogu cast?Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu, LucasfilmTwo big call-outs are that Pedro Pascal is returning as Din Djarin, while the legendary Sigourney Weaver is set to make her debut in the Star Wars galaxy.Which characters will be in the movie?Unsurprisingly, the Mandalorian (Din Djarin) and Grogu will be making an appearance in the upcoming film alongside Sigourney Weaver’s new character. It was also announced at Star Wars Celebration Japan 2025 that Garazeb “Zeb” Orrelios, a familiar favorite, will be making his appearance in the movie as well.When will The Mandalorian and Grogu be released?The Mandalorian and Grogu is set to premiere in US theaters May 22, 2026.Check out The Mandalorian and Grogu trailer on Disney+!For More from The Mandalorian and Grogu...The Mandalorian, LucasfilmCan’t wait until the movie arrives in theaters to see Mando and Grogu? See (or revisit) how their story began in the Disney+ Original series, The Mandalorian, all three seasons of the show are now streaming on Disney+.
